intent: IMPLEMENT ReorderWindow so the frozen test passes; Java 17, Spring Boot 3, non-blocking, no cross-context domain imports, no hardcoded config values. Spec: Telemetry Sequencing & Windowing domain (per-device, not thread-safe; caller synchronizes). Constructor ReorderWindow(Duration window, int capacity), both positive. Nested enum Outcome {IN_ORDER, BACKFILL, LATE}. Outcome offer(TelemetrySampleEvent e): IN_ORDER if e.tDevice >= highest tDevice seen; BACKFILL if highest - tDevice <= window (buffered); LATE if older than the window (NOT buffered, caller records it as revision). List<TelemetrySampleEvent> drainReady(): removes and returns buffered samples with tDevice <= highest - window ordered ascending by tDevice (ties by arrival); when buffer size exceeds capacity the oldest samples are also released so memory stays bounded. List<TelemetrySampleEvent> drainAll() releases everything ordered. Ordering uses tDevice only, never tIngress. VALIDATION_FAILED samples are ordered like any other; no revalidation. Window duration is a constructor parameter (no hardcoded 60s).
